judgments.evidenceText: Figure 1.1 charts selected global connectivity indicators from 1994 to 2025 in millions. Its labelled 2025 endpoints are 9,171 mobile-cellular subscriptions, 8,175 active mobile-broadband subscriptions, 6,047 Internet users, 1,654 fixed-broadband subscriptions and 815 fixed telephone lines. The figure reports counts in millions, not rates or unique subscribers.
